mentorship.title: Mentorship
text: Get paired with an upper-year student or alumnus who has been through the exam process and the internship search. The term starts with the Mentorship Kick-Off, where you meet your mentor or mentee, and includes a midterm check-in and a wrap-up event. Pairs also meet on their own throughout the term.
We are looking for both people who want a mentor and people willing to be one.

resume.title: Resume critique
text: Submit your resume and get written feedback from an exec or alumnus within a week, or come to a Resume Critique session for a live one-on-one review.
Reviewers are always welcome: you do not need to be a working actuary, only to know what a strong resume looks like.

opg.title: Out Performance Games (OPG)
opg.lead: The OPG is a pricing simulation stolen from Intact intern activities. Teams take over a book of insurance policyholders and compete to price it better than the other teams.
text: Every policyholder has up to five years of history: product (property or auto), group (A or B), age, number of accidents, paid claims and how those claims developed over time. In each session your team works through a simplified reserving and pricing worksheet, then submits rates.

Price too high and policyholders leave for cheaper teams. Price too low and you win a lot of business that loses money. After every session the market moves and everyone receives one more year of data.
steps: Receive your data package: the policyholders you currently insure and their full history.
Reserve: build development factors from the paid-claims triangle and estimate ultimate losses.
Indicate: turn ultimate losses into an expected loss cost for each product, group and age band.
Select rates: load for expenses and profit, and decide how you want to compare with the market.
Submit. Policyholders compare prices, move teams, and a new year of claims is revealed.
